cls:router_reference.description:
`write_hbus` updates the mirrored registers on every write to 0x1000/0x1001.
`write_yapp` applies the DUT's drop rules (disabled, length > maxpktsize, addr == 3)
and publishes survivors on `yapp_valid_out` -> scoreboard.
cls:router_reference.name: router_reference
cls:router_reference.summary: Mirrors maxpktsize and router_en from the HBUS traffic and forwards only the packets the router will route.

cls:router_scoreboard.description:
`write_yapp` clones the packet into `pkt_q[addr]`; `write_chan0/1/2` pop the head of
the matching queue and compare with `comp_equal()`. Counts matched / mismatched /
unexpected; `report_phase` prints the totals. Packets to address 3 are dropped here
in Lab 9A; from Lab 9B the reference model filters them first.

slave), creates everything, builds and locks the register model. `connect_phase`
wires the monitors to the module UVC, the virtual sequencer to the two sub-sequencers
and the register map to the HBUS sequencer through the adapter.

cls:yapp_packet.description:
One packet on the YAPP input port: header `{length[5:0], addr[1:0]}`, `length`
payload bytes, then an even-parity byte. `parity_type` (GOOD 5 : BAD 1) decides
whether `set_parity()` corrupts the computed parity. `packet_delay` is the gap the
driver waits before sending. Built in Lab 1, used everywhere after.

All pin activity lives in the interface task; the driver only sequences it and
records the transaction (`begin_tr`/`end_tr`).

and bad-parity packets; `num_bad_parity` is read by the register tests.

hw_top.dut.u_error_timer.name: u_error_timer
hw_top.dut.u_error_timer.summary: A free-running counter picks a delay 1..10; `error` pulses that many cycles after a bad-parity packet.

hw_top.dut.u_input_fsm.description:
The header is latched in IDLE (`cur_addr`, `cur_len`, `cur_drop`). Bytes are pushed into
the channel FIFO while `in_data_vld && !in_suspend`; `in_suspend` is asserted only when the
target FIFO is full and the packet is not dropped. In PARITY the accumulated XOR is compared
with the parity byte and the packet is reported to the register block (`pkt_done`,
`pkt_addr`, `pkt_len`, `pkt_parity_err`, `pkt_oversized`) in the same cycle. The
`ROUTER DROPS PACKET` messages come from here.

hw_top.dut.u_input_fsm.name: u_input_fsm
hw_top.dut.u_input_fsm.summary: IDLE -> PAYLOAD -> PARITY: accepts the header, decides drop, pushes bytes, checks parity.

hw_top.dut.u_regs.description:
1-cycle writes, 2-cycle reads with tri-state `hdata`. Counters and `mem_size_reg` are updated
from the FSM's end-of-packet report; `yapp_pkt_mem` through the `pkt_mem_*` write port.
The register model's backdoor root is `hw_top.dut.u_regs`. `INJECT_ERROR` lives here.

tb.router_module.reference.description:
`write_hbus` updates the mirrored registers on every write to 0x1000/0x1001.
`write_yapp` applies the DUT's drop rules (disabled, length > maxpktsize, addr == 3)
and publishes survivors on `yapp_valid_out` -> scoreboard.
tb.router_module.reference.name: reference
tb.router_module.reference.summary: Mirrors maxpktsize and router_en from the HBUS traffic and forwards only the packets the router will route.

tb.router_module.scoreboard.description:
`write_yapp` clones the packet into `pkt_q[addr]`; `write_chan0/1/2` pop the head of
the matching queue and compare with `comp_equal()`. Counts matched / mismatched /
unexpected; `report_phase` prints the totals. Packets to address 3 are dropped here
in Lab 9A; from Lab 9B the reference model filters them first.
tb.router_module.scoreboard.name: scoreboard
tb.router_module.scoreboard.summary: Four analysis imps: expected packets queued per address, compared with what each channel delivered.

tb.yapp.agent.summary: Monitor always; driver + sequencer only when is_active == UVM_ACTIVE.

tb.yapp.agent.driver.description:
`run_phase` resets the interface, waits for reset release, then loops
`seq_item_port.get_next_item(req)` -> `vif.send_to_dut(...)` -> `item_done()`.
All pin activity lives in the interface task; the driver only sequences it and
records the transaction (`begin_tr`/`end_tr`).
tb.yapp.agent.driver.name: driver
tb.yapp.agent.driver.note: Built only when is_active == UVM_ACTIVE (set_config_test makes the agent passive).
tb.yapp.agent.driver.summary: Gets packets from the sequencer and drives them pin by pin through yapp_if.

tb.yapp.agent.monitor.description:
`collect_packets` runs forever: one new `yapp_packet` per packet, published on
`item_collected_port` (Lab 9A) and sampled by `yapp_pkt_cg` (Lab 10). Counts packets
and bad-parity packets; `num_bad_parity` is read by the register tests.
tb.yapp.agent.monitor.name: monitor
tb.yapp.agent.monitor.summary: Samples yapp_if on the rising edge, rebuilds packets, publishes them and collects coverage.
